purpose: Canonical ordered value rows for one Event Agenda; position and content are durable Event-internal truth and do not create identity for individual Agenda parts.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.value_contract: References one existing Event expectation; the Agenda part does not receive its own NativeRef.

columns.name: position
columns.meaning: One-based canonical position inside the Event Agenda.
columns.value_contract: Integer from 1 through 100; contiguous ordering is maintained by the bounded create/mutation capabilities.

columns.name: content
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty text with at most 1000 characters.

primary_key.name: pk_event_agenda_part
primary_key.reason: One value occupies each ordered position of one Event Agenda.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_agenda_part_event_ref_event_expectation
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Agenda values are owned by the canonical Event expectation rather than becoming standalone temporal owners.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_agenda_part_position
check_constraints.reason: Bound the ordered Agenda to the accepted B03-D maximum of 100 values.

check_constraints.name: ck_event_agenda_part_content
check_constraints.reason: Reject empty, padded or unbounded Agenda content at the database boundary.

indexes.name: pk_event_agenda_part
indexes.reason: Ordered Event Agenda lookup and position uniqueness.

state_history.current_binding: The complete ordered row set is current Agenda truth; aggregate concurrency is governed by event_agenda_current.
state_history.chronology: Agenda position is ordering, not chronology. Mutation chronology lives in accepted operation receipts and updated_at on the aggregate revision.
state_history.immutability_policy: Runtime receives read-only table access; replacement is available only through the bounded SECURITY DEFINER capability.

lifecycle.retention: Retained with the Event until an accepted Agenda replacement changes the ordered value set.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime cannot DELETE directly; replacement capability may atomically replace/remove Agenda values as one governed aggregate mutation.

obligations: Agenda parts have no standalone NativeRef or Schedule/Session/Actual identity
content and cardinality bounds are enforced
